record.text: How will it look on its outer screen and on the inner screen? Does it support landscape orientation well? Does it support multitasking use cases? What happens when users interact with my app when the iPhone Duo is partially folded? The iOS app development has just gotten more complicated. [3/3]

From now on, you can’t just make an app for traditional iPhone and call it a day. Now, every iOS developer has to essentially make two very different versions of every app they develop. You have to constantly ask yourself: how will my app work on the iPhone Duo? [2/3]

The differences between iOS 27 for traditional iPhone models and iOS 27 for the iPhone Duo are massive. They mean a lot for developers too. If you are an iOS developer today, this forking of iOS dramatically changes how you think about your development process. [1/3]

It’s hard to expect any of that will change under Cook’s hand-picked successor. The iPhone Duo is not just an evolution of the iPhone, but comes with an eye-watering price of between $1999 to $3199 in the United States. Canadians and Australians can expect to pay 10% more even after adjusting for the exchange rate, and in some markets like Turkey or Brazil it’s far higher. Sure, there are higher component costs now, but the company seems to be taking even greater advantage of international markets to eke out some further margin.

The $100 hike in the cost of the new iPhone Pro models can be explained by the memory price hikes affected the entire consumer electronics industry. The company hiked the prices of other products like Macs and iPads back in June. But the iPhone Duo’s price is a continuation of Cook’s strategy to ensure iPhone users pay more for their phones over time, not to mention how the base iPhone 18 won’t even get released until next year. A folding iPhone might be a new gimmick, but it’s also an opportunity to push the average price of an iPhone even higher.
